directive_basis: R407-B: build the physical-observation ingestion contract — REALITY_EVENT with mandatory experiment_id, package_id, timestamp, apparatus_id, operator, raw_data_hash, processed_data_hash, measurement_units, uncertainty, baseline_result, candidate_result, pre_registered_threshold, decision. No physical observation should enter the system without provenance.
constitutional_basis: Art. XXXVIII (the Reality Boundary: AI may not claim reality happened unless reality produced the evidence; the R370G REALITY_EVENT schema is the base layer), Art. VI (never manufacture provenance), Art. XII (provenance custody chain), Art. XXV (unknown stays unknown; UNKNOWN apparatus/operator values are legitimate — blank or missing is not), Art. XXXVII (CONTROLLED_REHEARSAL never promotes, never counts as learning)

mandatory_fields.experiment_id: the frozen experiment contract this observation answers (e.g. P04-R407-EXP-001); binds the observation to its pre-registered thresholds
mandatory_fields.apparatus_id: identity of the physical apparatus that produced the data (serial/registry id; 'UNKNOWN' is legitimate, blank is not)
mandatory_fields.operator: the human or instrument operator of record (identity + organization; 'UNKNOWN' is legitimate, blank is not)
mandatory_fields.raw_data_hash: sha256 of the RAW acquisition bytes (traces, images, logs) BEFORE any processing — the attestation binds to this
mandatory_fields.processed_data_hash: sha256 of the processed dataset the results are computed from (the processing script must itself be committed; the raw->processed step is part of the custody chain)
mandatory_fields.measurement_units: explicit units for every measured quantity in the results (bare numbers are forbidden)
mandatory_fields.uncertainty: the stated uncertainty of the measurement (per-quantity; resolution + repeatability class)
mandatory_fields.baseline_result: the control-arm result (Art. XLVII: the baseline is measured, not assumed)
mandatory_fields.candidate_result: the treatment-arm result, structured per the frozen contract's endpoint schema
mandatory_fields.pre_registered_threshold: the threshold set the decision was computed against (must hash-match the frozen contract's registered values)
mandatory_fields.decision: the machine verdict computed by the frozen contract's decision function — {verdict, rule_id, rule_trace}; free-text decisions are rejected at ingestion

art_XXXVIII_base.custody_chain: non-empty list of {actor, action, timestamp} steps from acquisition to ingestion
art_XXXVIII_base.attestation: attestation_text + attestation_hash binding the bytes to the acquisition event
art_XXXVIII_base.provenance_validated: must be true (the validator sets it only after the schema passes)

ledger.format: append-only JSON ledger; each entry carries {prev_entry_sha256, entry_sha256 = H(prev | record)}; ingestion rejects duplicate event_ids; verify_ledger() recomputes the chain and detects any mutation of a past entry
ledger.real_ledger: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P04/REALITY_LOOP/REALITY_LEDGER.json (EMPTY at registration — zero entries; the first real observation will be entry 1)
ledger.rehearsal_ledgers: separate REHEARSAL_* ledgers (CONTROLLED_REHEARSAL source_type can NEVER enter the real ledger — the ingestion layer classifies by source_type and the ledger files are physically separate)
ledger.promotion_rule: an observation advances a package's loop chain only through discovery_fabric/engine/loop_chain.py (Art. XXXVIII transition rules); ingestion alone changes nothing — it is the gate, not the promoter

decision_functions.other_packages: a frozen contract + decision function pair must exist BEFORE an observation can be ingested for that package (no contract, no ingestion — no post-hoc thresholds)

anti_fabrication_guards: the decision field is RECOMPUTED by the machine function at test time and compared to the stored verdict (tamper-evident)
raw_data_hash must be a sha256 of bytes that exist in custody (raw artifact committed or custody-referenced); the attestation text must name the acquisition event
CONTROLLED_REHEARSAL events are structurally valid but can never promote a chain or produce a learning verdict (adjudicate_learning returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA for rehearsal source types)
the ingestion validator rejects any event whose candidate_result does not carry explicit units and uncertainty (bare numbers are unverifiable claims)
no_observation_without_provenance: this is the whole contract: an observation missing any mandatory field is rejected at the boundary — it never becomes evidence, never enters a ledger, never updates a model (fail-closed, Art. XIV)
